ministries.name: YWAM Impact Philippines (IWT Philippines)
ministries.blurb: A YWAM training base in coastal, agricultural Maragondon that runs discipleship schools, campus evangelism, feeding programs, maternal-care classes and livelihood projects while sending Filipino missionaries.

ministries.name: YWAM Antipolo Training Center (ATC)
ministries.blurb: A YWAM training center on the edge of Metro Manila since 1990, with about 23 staff running training schools and children's, youth and sponsorship programs.

ministries.name: YWAM Kalinga Philippines
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base serving tribal communities of rice-farming Kalinga province through youth development, women's empowerment and leadership training.

ministries.name: YWAM Davao
ministries.blurb: A YWAM center of around 27 staff in Davao City running training schools plus prison, children's and social-service ministries.

ministries.name: YWAM Bacolod City
ministries.blurb: A small pioneering YWAM base on the outskirts of Bacolod with farming capacity, running children's, youth, campus and community outreach.

ministries.name: YWAM Baguio Training Center
ministries.blurb: The first permanent YWAM location in the Philippines (1972) and mother base for others, training missionaries and reaching overlooked peoples of the Cordillera.

ministries.name: YWAM Baguio Urban Ministries Center
ministries.blurb: A small YWAM team of about five staff focused on urban ministry in Baguio City.

ministries.name: YWAM Iloilo
ministries.blurb: A YWAM missionary training and outreach center in Molo, Iloilo, in Western Visayas.

ministries.name: YWAM Cebu (Mobile Discipleship Ministry)
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base of about 21 staff near Cebu City doing discipleship training, evangelism, mercy ministry and church planting.

ministries.name: YWAM Cebu House of Prayer (CebuHOP)
ministries.blurb: A YWAM house-of-prayer ministry in Cebu City offering prayer, training, discipleship and outreach.

ministries.name: YWAM Puerto Princesa City
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base in Irawan, Puerto Princesa, running DTS and focused training and serving the poor, prisoners, schools and children in Palawan.

ministries.name: YWAM Tacloban City
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base begun after Typhoon Yolanda (2013) that trains and sends young people from Eastern Visayas, houses college students and runs feeding programs.

ministries.name: YWAM Butuan City
ministries.blurb: A growing YWAM base in Mindanao doing community development, family care, street-children outreach, youth discipleship and evangelism from a youth center.

ministries.name: YWAM Mercylink Philippines (Mercylink Global Ministry Foundation)
ministries.blurb: A YWAM-affiliated Christian non-profit in Calapan, Oriental Mindoro, doing training and humanitarian work.

ministries.name: YWAM King's Kids International Philippines
ministries.blurb: A YWAM King's Kids base in Nasugbu running youth discipleship, children's Bible classes and community ministry.

ministries.name: YWAM Mandaluyong
ministries.blurb: A YWAM hub for performing arts in Metro Manila doing discipleship training and arts-based ministry.

ministries.name: YWAM Cagayan de Oro City
ministries.blurb: A YWAM center of about 15 staff doing evangelism, mercy ministry, training and community outreach in northern Mindanao.

ministries.name: YWAM Dumaguete
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base in the university city of Dumaguete running campus ministry, a university DTS and King's Kids performing arts.

ministries.name: YWAM General Santos
ministries.blurb: A small YWAM base of around three staff in General Santos, South Cotabato.

ministries.name: YWAM Laguna (San Pedro)
ministries.blurb: A small YWAM base reaching poor communities in and around San Pedro, Laguna, hosting small outreach teams.

ministries.name: YWAM Dagupan
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base ministering in four slum communities of Dagupan, where it has planted a church.

ministries.name: YWAM Calbayog
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base in Western Samar focused on discipleship training, evangelism, mercy ministry and church planting.

ministries.name: YWAM Bukidnon
ministries.blurb: A YWAM base in Malaybalay City, about 100 km south of Cagayan de Oro, with around ten staff running training schools.

ministries.name: Real LIFE Foundation
ministries.blurb: An Every Nation / Victory-linked foundation started in 2007 that gives scholarships, mentoring and coaching to students from poor families across the Philippines.

ministries.name: Action International Ministries Philippines
ministries.blurb: A Christian mission that runs vocational training and discipleship for youth from poor families of Metro Manila and nearby provinces, among other ministries.

ministries.name: Emmanuel Relief and Rehabilitation Philippines (Emmanuel International)
ministries.blurb: The Philippine arm of Emmanuel International, partnering with local churches in Mindanao on church planting, community development (water, health, agriculture), student sponsorship and disaster relief among tribal groups.

ministries.name: Chosen Children Village Foundation, Inc.
ministries.blurb: A Christian residential village in Silang giving a permanent home, schooling, therapy and training to abandoned, neglected and surrendered children with physical and intellectual disabilities. The campus has cottages, a chapel, a school, a clinic and physical therapy centers.

ministries.name: Children's Shelter of Cebu
ministries.blurb: A Christ-centered ministry that has run homes for orphaned, abandoned and surrendered children in Cebu City since 1979, with medical, educational and placement services and its own school, Cebu Children of Hope School.

ministries.name: Kids International Ministries (KIDS)
ministries.blurb: A Christian ministry working since 2005 in the poor community of Cuatro and in Tondo, Manila. It runs children's homes, Cuatro Christian School, a pregnancy clinic and crisis pregnancy home, and church-based feeding programs.

ministries.name: Tahanan Sta. Luisa, Inc.
ministries.blurb: A crisis intervention and recovery home for girls aged 9 to 18 rescued from the streets of Metro Manila after abuse and sexual exploitation. It provides residential care, counseling, schooling and life-skills training.

ministries.name: Tahanan ng Pagmamahal Children's Home, Inc.
ministries.blurb: A DSWD-licensed Christian children's home in Pasig caring for abandoned, neglected, surrendered and foundling children from infancy to early teens, with education and healthcare support.

ministries.name: Manaoag Christian Children's Home (Philippines Orphanage Foundation)
ministries.blurb: A small orphanage for infants and young children run with Manaoag Christian Baptist Church and funded by the US-based Philippines Orphanage Foundation (now becoming Living Hope Children's Mission). It runs a homeschool program and has an in-house social worker.

ministries.name: Hospicio de San Jose
ministries.blurb: A Catholic social welfare institution run in the mission of the Daughters of Charity since 1810, on an island in the Pasig River. It cares for abandoned and neglected children, survivors of abuse and trafficking, older persons, people with special needs and people in crisis.

ministries.name: Preda Foundation (People's Recovery, Empowerment and Development Assistance)
ministries.blurb: Founded in 1974 by Columban missionary Fr. Shay Cullen, Preda rescues sexually abused and trafficked children and children held in jails. It runs therapeutic homes for girls and boys in Olongapo.

ministries.name: Mary Queen of Heaven Missionaries (Home of Love)
ministries.blurb: A Catholic missionary community that rescues women and girls from sex trafficking and rehabilitates them at its Home of Love in Tuburan, Cebu. Its Regina Coeli Educational Program sends rural children to school to prevent exploitation.

ministries.name: Wipe Every Tear
ministries.blurb: A Christian anti-trafficking ministry that reaches women in the bars of Angeles City, runs safe homes and pays for survivors' college education.

ministries.name: Noah's Ark Ministries
ministries.blurb: A children's home in Banaue with room for up to 50 orphaned, abandoned and malnourished children. It also runs a special needs learning centre, school scholarships and infant nutrition support in Ifugao's mountain villages.

ministries.name: Obed's House Ministries
ministries.blurb: A 24/7 Christian residential home in General Santos City, open since 2013, that gives neglected children aged 5 to 12 a family setting and aims to raise Christ-centered community leaders.

ministries.name: Little Children of the Philippines (Little Children of the World)
ministries.blurb: A Christ-focused ministry in Dumaguete that serves children at risk through its HELPS model: health, education, livelihood and faith programs, plus child sponsorship.

ministries.name: Island Kids Philippines
ministries.blurb: A Swiss and German-backed charity grounded in Christian love of neighbor. Since 2007 it has run a community learning center in Cagayan de Oro for about 450 children from a waste-picker community, plus vocational training and a regenerative farm.

ministries.name: Shepherd of the Hills Children's Foundation
ministries.blurb: A Christian children's home on Kennon Road, Camp 7, Baguio, caring for abandoned, neglected, abused and underprivileged children since 1976.

ministries.name: Philippine Children's Mission Inc.
ministries.blurb: A Christian home, running since 1960, that shelters and cares for disadvantaged children, including orphans and children of parents with leprosy or other debilitating diseases. It supports them through elementary, high school, college and life-skills training.

ministries.name: Silliman University
ministries.blurb: Protestant university founded by American Presbyterian missionaries, offering basic, college and graduate education in Dumaguete. It posts its staff and faculty openings on its own careers page.

ministries.name: Central Philippine University
ministries.blurb: Baptist university in Jaro, Iloilo City, founded by American Baptist missionaries. It runs colleges from social work to medicine and law, and a university church.

ministries.name: Faith International Academy
ministries.blurb: Christian K-12 international school in Davao City that teaches a US-based curriculum to the children of missionaries, expatriates and local families. Its staff are largely Christian workers who raise their own support.

ministries.name: Doane Rest (ABWE guesthouse)
ministries.blurb: ABWE-run guesthouse and retreat center where international missionaries, Filipino pastors and other Christian workers can rest.

ministries.name: Asian Theological Seminary
ministries.blurb: Evangelical graduate seminary in Quezon City that has trained pastors and church leaders since 1969.

ministries.name: Biblical Seminary of the Philippines
ministries.blurb: Independent, non-profit evangelical seminary in Valenzuela that trains pastors and ministry workers.

ministries.name: Asia Pacific Theological Seminary
ministries.blurb: Assemblies of God graduate seminary in Baguio that trains pastors, missionaries and Christian educators from across Asia and the Pacific.

ministries.name: Bicol Center for Christian Leadership (Bicol Bible College of Leadership)
ministries.blurb: Filipino-led leadership training center, supported by North American Baptists, that trains ministry leaders in the Bicol region. It runs certificate programs, food and Bible distribution and a business-as-mission café.

ministries.name: Tribal Bible College project (IMB, Bicol)
ministries.blurb: IMB-backed effort to start a self-sustaining Bible college that trains church leaders and missionaries from tribal groups in the Bicol region, with farming as part of the training.

ministries.name: World Team Philippines
ministries.blurb: Mission agency whose church-planting teams in the Philippines work in Metro Manila's urban poor communities, in theological education and in mercy and justice ministries.

ministries.name: World Team Philippines - Naga College Ministry
ministries.blurb: World Team campus ministry that reaches students at five universities in Naga City and also works in Caramoan.

ministries.name: KMBI (A Microfinance NGO)
ministries.blurb: Christ-centered microfinance NGO serving more than 160,000 low-income women micro-entrepreneurs from over 110 offices. It has been in operation since 1986.

ministries.name: International Care Ministries (ICM)
ministries.blurb: Christian NGO serving ultra-poor families in the central and southern Philippines through its Transform program of values, health and livelihood training. It is headquartered in Ortigas.

ministries.name: Philippine Jesuit Prison Service (PJPS)
ministries.blurb: Catholic Jesuit ministry based at New Bilibid Prison that gives health care, paralegal help, pastoral formation and reintegration support to persons deprived of liberty. It also funds scholarships for their children.

ministries.name: CIW Prison Ministry (ABWE / Freedom in Christ Baptist Church)
ministries.blurb: Bible study, worship and discipleship ministry inside the Correctional Institution for Women. Trained inmate leaders called Lightbearers help lead it, and it has run since 2000.

ministries.name: Brent International School Manila
ministries.blurb: Episcopal-founded, college-preparatory international day school with campuses in Laguna, Subic and Baguio.

ministries.name: Philippine Bible Society
ministries.blurb: The national Bible society, working since 1899, translates, publishes and distributes Scripture across the Philippines. It runs programs such as Adopt-a-Church, trauma healing and a Filipino Sign Language Bible translation.

ministries.name: Church of the Nazarene – Philippines Mindoro District
ministries.blurb: A Nazarene district on Mindoro that grew from one surviving church after the pandemic to seven congregations, with outreach to tribal and underserved communities.

ministries.name: Church of the Nazarene – Palawan
ministries.blurb: Nazarene ministry in Palawan doing local church outreach, neighborhood children's programs, prison ministry and work with highland tribal communities.

ministries.name: Nazarene Compassionate Ministries / Nazarene Disaster Response Philippines
ministries.blurb: Church of the Nazarene relief teams in the Philippines that mobilize local churches and volunteers after typhoons and earthquakes, providing food, water, shelter and trauma-informed care for children.

ministries.name: Grace International World Outreach (Shepherds Home / Grace Bible Training Center)
ministries.blurb: A Mississippi-based mission whose Philippine base in Kalibo runs a Bible training center and plants churches in Aklan, Panay's tribal highlands (Tapaz) and Mindoro, often building simple native churches with local labor.

ministries.name: Caritas Philippines
ministries.blurb: The humanitarian and development arm of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines, channeling diocesan relief and rehabilitation after disasters.

ministries.name: Couples for Christ Global Mission Foundation (Build My Church)
ministries.blurb: Couples for Christ's Build My Church program funds construction and repair of chapels in poor communities; with the Diocese of Baguio it is building a mission-station chapel in Nangalisan, Tuba.

ministries.name: Suwalin Evangelical Fellowship
ministries.blurb: An Acts 29 church launched in November 2023 that serves among Mindoro's indigenous Mangyan as cross-cultural missionaries, strengthening tribal churches and mobilizing them to plant new ones.

ministries.name: One Mission Society Philippines (The Juan Project)
ministries.blurb: OMS's Philippine church-planting movement, The Juan Project, trains pastors and leaders across the provinces toward saturation church planting.

ministries.name: Brand New Day (ACTION International Ministries)
ministries.blurb: A residential care, drop-in and tutoring ministry for abandoned, abused and neglected young people, currently in rented housing that fits only 14 children.

ministries.name: Project Pag-asa (ACTION International Ministries)
ministries.blurb: A trauma-informed Christian school for children from orphanages who have experienced abuse, abandonment and neglect, grown from 10 students in 2014 to over 60.

ministries.name: Timothy Project International Mission – Lighthouse Home for Kids
ministries.blurb: Founded in 2017, the Lighthouse gives temporary shelter, care and rehabilitation to abandoned newborns, abused children and teens, and promotes foster care with local churches.

ministries.name: Church of God Philippines – Tribal Learning Centers
ministries.blurb: Church of God (Anderson) churches installing Wi-Fi hubs in rural and tribal congregations so children can receive lessons streamed from Manila Church of God schools.

ministries.name: Ethnos360 – Southern Tagbanwa Church Planting
ministries.blurb: Ethnos360 work among the Southern Tagbanwa of Palawan since 1978, now about 1,500 believers in 19 village churches, with translation, medical and community development work.

ministries.name: IMB From Mission Field to Mission Force Team
ministries.blurb: An International Mission Board team training national believers in the southern Philippines to take the gospel to unreached indigenous groups and plant churches.

ministries.name: The Poor Household of God (with the Oikos Sisters)
ministries.blurb: A US charity supporting the Oikos Sisters' work with the poorest families of Borongan: education, food, shelter, medical and dental care, gardens and livelihood programs.

ministries.name: Global Health Outreach (CMDA) – Leyte team
ministries.blurb: The short-term missions arm of the Christian Medical & Dental Associations sends yearly medical and dental teams to underserved Matalom, Leyte, including clinic days on a small offshore island with almost no local healthcare.

ministries.name: Adventist Medical Center Manila
ministries.blurb: Seventh-day Adventist hospital in Manila that partners with AdventHealth Global Missions on annual free primary-care clinics for poor communities near the hospital.

ministries.name: Adventist Medical Center Bacolod
ministries.blurb: Adventist hospital on Negros, part of the Adventist Hospitals of the Philippines network, working with AdventHealth on surgical care and a new cardiac catheterization lab.

ministries.name: Helping Hands Medical Missions – Philippines
ministries.blurb: Christian medical mission agency bringing surgical, medical and dental care with the Gospel to the Tanauan/Talisay area of Batangas; 16 Philippine missions since 2005 serving more than 29,700 patients.

ministries.name: Palawan Baptist Hospital
ministries.blurb: A 12-bed ABWE-related mission hospital in Roxas, Palawan, with emergency, surgical, pediatric and OB care, a chaplain and community outreach for a mostly low-income population.

ministries.name: Mercy In Action – Imago Dei Health & Birth Center
ministries.blurb: Christian midwifery ministry running free birth centers for families in poverty in Olongapo and Tanauan, Leyte, with prenatal home visits, maternity waiting homes and emergency referral; over 17,500 babies delivered.

ministries.name: Rosa Mystica Medical Mission
ministries.blurb: Catholic medical mission (ACIM/AMEP) holding a yearly week of free clinics in the Sarangani mountains near General Santos, with Filipino volunteers providing patient follow-up all year.

ministries.name: ANCOP Foundation (Couples for Christ) – Medical Missions
ministries.blurb: Catholic Couples for Christ foundation running medical, dental, optical and physical therapy missions in poor provinces; its January 2026 mission in four Romblon towns served 4,829 people.

ministries.name: German Doctors – Philippines (Mindoro & Luzon rolling clinics)
ministries.blurb: Volunteer-doctor organization with Christian roots, active in the Philippines since 1983, running mobile clinics and health-worker training for Mangyan communities on Mindoro and indigenous groups in remote Luzon.

ministries.name: Hope 4 Kids International – Philippines
ministries.blurb: Christian child-focused ministry serving agricultural workers' families and single mothers in Victoria, Mindoro and in Marikina, with child sponsorship, feeding and medical outreach trips.

ministries.name: Operation Blessing Foundation Philippines (CBN Asia)
ministries.blurb: Humanitarian arm of CBN Asia, founded 1996, running mobile medical clinics, disaster response, hunger relief and water and sanitation projects for neglected communities across the Philippines.

ministries.name: Faith Academy
ministries.blurb: Accredited K-12 Christian international school east of Manila that educates the children of missionary families so they can stay on the field longer.

ministries.name: Davao City International Church (AGWM church plant)
ministries.blurb: An Assemblies of God World Missions team planting an English-speaking, multicultural, missions-sending church in Davao City.

ministries.name: Final Harvest Project
ministries.blurb: Mobilizes and trains Filipino missionaries for hard-to-reach areas of the southern Philippines and runs the Kids Helping Kids sponsorship and Restore500 microbusiness ministries.

ministries.name: Happy Horizons Children's Ranch
ministries.blurb: Christian aftercare home in Cebu for girls rescued from sexual abuse, exploitation and trafficking, with a school, church and medical clinic on campus.

ministries.name: World Team Philippines - Reefs for Life (Caramoan)
ministries.blurb: World Team church-planting team using coral reef restoration and creation care to serve and reach remote coastal communities around Caramoan.

ministries.name: World Team Philippines - Naga City church plant
ministries.blurb: World Team church-planting effort in Naga City reaching college students and establishing a new local church.

ministries.name: SIM Philippines
ministries.blurb: SIM's Philippine office, which mobilizes Filipino churches for mission and runs ethnic and migrant ministries and member support services.

ministries.name: MTW Mangyan Ministry (All Nations Mission School)
ministries.blurb: Mission to the World team overseeing 45 churches planted among the Indigenous Mangyan people and training Mangyan pastors through a local mission school and the Timothy Project.

ministries.name: Working Hands Vocational Training (ACTION Philippines)
ministries.blurb: ACTION vocational school training young people from poor families of Metro Manila and nearby provinces in trades while discipling them.

ministries.name: Shalom Christian Birthing Home
ministries.blurb: Christian birthing home and clinic run with ACTION that provides maternity and outpatient care to poor families in Antipolo.

ministries.name: ACTION Island Ministry (Iloilo)
ministries.blurb: ACTION discipleship and evangelism ministry living within a resettlement community of families relocated after a 2014 typhoon, also reaching remote islands.

ministries.name: OMF International - Philippines Field
ministries.blurb: OMF's Philippines field team of 50+ members partners with Filipino churches in church planting, theological education and community work.

ministries.name: Diocese of Legazpi Social Action Center
ministries.blurb: The Catholic diocese's social action office in Albay, which runs relief drives and opens parishes as evacuation centers when Mayon Volcano and typhoons displace families.

ministries.name: Diocese of Marbel Social Action Center
ministries.blurb: Social action arm of the Catholic Diocese of Marbel, covering General Santos City, South Cotabato and Sarangani, which led relief after the June 2026 magnitude 7.8 Mindanao earthquake, including to indigenous communities around Lake Sebu.

ministries.name: Christian and Missionary Alliance Churches of the Philippines (CAMACOP)
ministries.blurb: A national evangelical church network with over 120 years in the Philippines; its congregations in Sarangani and South Cotabato distributed food, water and hygiene kits and offered trauma counseling after the June 2026 earthquake.

ministries.name: UCCP CARES (United Church of Christ in the Philippines Aid and Relief Services)
ministries.blurb: The disaster response ministry of the United Church of Christ in the Philippines, formed after Typhoon Haiyan, now supplying food, shelter, medical and psychosocial care to Sarangani earthquake survivors.

ministries.name: National Council of Churches in the Philippines (NCCP)
ministries.blurb: An ecumenical council of Protestant and independent churches and an ACT Alliance member, running cash, food, WASH and psychosocial assistance for families displaced by the June 2026 Mindanao earthquake.

ministries.name: The Mustard Seed Mission (Philippines earthquake response)
ministries.blurb: A Christian relief mission founded in 1952 that, with local partners PHILRADS, SEND International and church networks, is running a three-phase relief-to-rebuilding program after the 2026 Mindanao earthquake.

ministries.name: The Wesleyan Church of the Philippines (Southern Mindanao District)
ministries.blurb: A Wesleyan denomination whose Southern Mindanao District lost six church buildings and its district center in the June 2026 earthquake and is clearing sites while distributing water and rice to members and neighbors.

ministries.name: Church of the Nazarene Philippines (Nazarene Compassionate Ministries)
ministries.blurb: Nazarene congregations in General Santos City and T'boli, with the church's compassionate ministries arm, providing food, children's care and shelter rehabilitation after earthquakes and typhoons.

ministries.name: ADRA Philippines (Adventist Development and Relief Agency)
ministries.blurb: The Seventh-day Adventist Church's humanitarian agency in the Philippines, working in emergency response, health, education and livelihoods.

ministries.name: Habitat for Humanity Philippines
ministries.blurb: The Philippine affiliate of the Christian housing ministry, building disaster-resilient core shelters, providing shelter repair after disasters and training communities in preparedness.

ministries.name: Samaritan's Purse (Cebu earthquake response)
ministries.blurb: Christian relief organization working through local churches and Operation Christmas Child networks in Bogo, Tabogon and San Remigio, distributing shelter kits, food and hygiene kits after the September 2025 Cebu earthquake.

ministries.name: Operation Blessing (Philippines)
ministries.blurb: Christian humanitarian organization whose Philippine team delivered meals, water filtration, hygiene kits, medical care and psychological first aid in Cebu after the 2025 earthquake and typhoons.

ministries.name: Philippine Relief and Development Services (PHILRADS)
ministries.blurb: The relief and development arm of the Philippine Council of Evangelical Churches, assessing needs and deploying relief with local churches in the 2026 Mindanao earthquake zone.

ministries.name: Archdiocese of Cebu
ministries.blurb: The Catholic archdiocese of Cebu, whose northern parishes, including the Sta. Rosa de Lima shrine in Daanbantayan and heritage churches in Bogo, San Remigio and Bantayan, were heavily damaged in the September 2025 earthquake.

needs.title: DBS staff to mentor Bible school students
needs.detail: Volunteer staff are wanted for the Discipleship Bible School to mentor students, help with lectures, lead small groups and give practical support. DTS completion is required; prior YWAM or DBS experience helps but is not essential.

needs.title: DTS staff for discipleship schools
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed to run and mentor students in the base's Discipleship Training Schools. YWAM asks staff to have completed a Discipleship Training School (DTS) first.

needs.title: Farming and agriculture staff
needs.detail: The base lists a long-term opening for someone to work its farm and agriculture projects, which support livelihood and feeding work in this rural town.

needs.title: Chef and kitchen staff
needs.detail: Long-term kitchen staff and a cook are wanted to prepare meals for the base community and its schools.

needs.title: Hospitality and hosting team members
needs.detail: The base needs long-term staff to host guests and visiting teams and run accommodation.

needs.title: Construction and facility maintenance staff
needs.detail: Builders and maintenance workers are wanted long-term to construct and maintain the base's buildings and grounds.

needs.title: Communication and media team member
needs.detail: The base is recruiting long-term staff for its communication and media team to create content about its ministries.

needs.title: Worship leader on staff
needs.detail: A long-term staff worship leader is wanted to lead worship for the base community and schools.

needs.title: Mission Builders for short-term construction
needs.detail: Short-term Mission Builders are invited to join building projects on the base.

needs.title: Youth ministry staff
needs.detail: Short-term staff (under six months) are wanted to serve in the center's youth ministry.

needs.title: Children's ministry staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed for the center's children's ministry.

needs.title: Kitchen personnel
needs.detail: The training center needs long-term kitchen personnel to feed staff and students.

needs.title: Building maintenance staff
needs.detail: Long-term building maintenance staff are wanted to keep the center's facilities running.

needs.title: House mothers for sponsored students
needs.detail: The center lists a long-term role for women to serve as mothers to the students it sponsors.

needs.title: Accountant/administrator and DTS staff
needs.detail: The base is looking for long-term staff to handle accounting and administration, and to staff its Discipleship Training School. YWAM asks staff to have completed a Discipleship Training School (DTS) first.

needs.title: Farm and agriculture management volunteer
needs.detail: A volunteer with farming knowledge is wanted for one to two years to manage the base's farm as part of its community-development work. DTS graduates only. Listing updated September 2026.

needs.title: Logistics staff and Mission Builders
needs.detail: Long-term logistics staff and Mission Builders are wanted to support operations and building work at the base.

needs.title: Prison ministry staff
needs.detail: YWAM Davao wants staff for six months to a year to serve in its prison ministry. YWAM asks staff to have completed a Discipleship Training School (DTS) first.

needs.title: Social service ministry volunteer
needs.detail: A long-term volunteer is needed for the base's social-service ministry among poor communities.

needs.title: DTS school staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed to lead and mentor Discipleship Training School students.

needs.title: Children's ministry staff
needs.detail: The base lists a long-term opening in children's ministry.

needs.title: Construction and facility maintenance
needs.detail: Long-term construction and maintenance help is wanted for the base facilities.

needs.title: Director for King's Kids camp school (PCYM)
needs.detail: A leader is needed to direct the base's King's Kids ministry camp school (PCYM). Applicants must have staffed two PCYM schools before and completed a DTS. Listing updated 31 Aug 2026.

needs.title: Short-term volunteer staff
needs.detail: The pioneering base welcomes short-term volunteer staff to help across its ministries.

needs.title: Children's ministry coordinator
needs.detail: A long-term coordinator is wanted to lead the base's children's ministry.

needs.title: Campus ministry staff
needs.detail: Full-time or short-term staff are needed for outreach and discipleship on Bacolod campuses.

needs.title: DTS coordinator
needs.detail: The base needs a long-term coordinator for its Discipleship Training School.

needs.title: Community outreach staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are wanted to run community outreach around the base.

needs.title: Construction and facility maintenance
needs.detail: Builders and maintenance workers are needed as the pioneering base develops its property.

needs.title: Bookkeeper/accountant
needs.detail: The training center is seeking a long-term bookkeeper or accountant.

needs.title: Admin for immigration and government registrations
needs.detail: An administrator is needed to help the national office manage staff records, prepare government registrations and reports, and assist with accounting and correspondence. Clerical experience and willingness to learn immigration processes required, plus DTS. Updated 27 Aug 2026.

needs.title: IT, web and graphic design staff
needs.detail: The base wants someone to maintain its website, make social media content, train staff in digital content and support computers; advanced candidates could build an interactive site for youth evangelism. DTS required.

needs.title: Communication staff
needs.detail: Long-term communication staff are wanted to tell the base's story.

needs.title: Church planting staff
needs.detail: The base seeks long-term staff for church planting among unreached communities in the region.

needs.title: Children's ministry staff
needs.detail: Long-term children's ministry staff are needed.

needs.title: Hospitality staff
needs.detail: Long-term hospitality staff are wanted to host students and guests.

needs.title: Short-term maintenance staff
needs.detail: Short-term maintenance help is wanted for the training center's facilities.

needs.title: Worship leader on staff
needs.detail: The urban ministries center wants a long-term staff worship leader.

needs.title: Urban ministry staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed to serve in the center's urban ministries in Baguio.

needs.title: Communication and media staff
needs.detail: YWAM Iloilo is recruiting communication and media staff.

needs.title: Staff for children, youth and campus ministry
needs.detail: Staff are needed to run children's, youth and campus ministries.

needs.title: Accountant/administrator and DTS staff
needs.detail: The base wants someone for accounting and administration who can also staff its DTS.

needs.title: Community development worker
needs.detail: Mission-minded people with a biblical worldview and community-development skills are welcome for any length of service.

needs.title: Medical staff for outreach (Mission Builders)
needs.detail: YWAM Cebu wants short-term medical staff with a heart for healthcare missions to join its outreach work. A DTS (or willingness to do one) is expected.

needs.title: Member care staff
needs.detail: Staff are wanted to provide member care for the base's missionaries.

needs.title: Kids ministry staff
needs.detail: The base needs staff for its kids ministry.

needs.title: Drivers
needs.detail: Drivers are needed to support the base's mobile ministry and outreaches.

needs.title: Promotions and social media coordinator
needs.detail: CebuHOP wants a long-term coordinator for promotions and social media.

needs.title: Prayer room, DTS, accounting and admin staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed for the prayer room, the Discipleship Training School, and accounting/admin.

needs.title: Logistics staff and Mission Builders
needs.detail: Short-term logistics staff and Mission Builders are wanted.

needs.title: Prison ministry staff
needs.detail: The base is recruiting long-term staff for its prison ministry in Palawan.

needs.title: Farm manager
needs.detail: A long-term farm manager is wanted for the base's farm.

needs.title: Student ministry staff
needs.detail: Staff are needed for ministry among students and schools.

needs.title: DTS staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed for the base's Discipleship Training School.

needs.title: Kitchen manager for students and feeding program
needs.detail: A kitchen manager is wanted to run meals for college students living at the base and its weekly feeding programs. DTS completion required.

needs.title: Full-time or short-term staff
needs.detail: The small base welcomes full-time and short-term staff across its ministries.

needs.title: DTS staff
needs.detail: YWAM Butuan wants staff for its Discipleship Training School.

needs.title: Teacher
needs.detail: Mercylink is looking for a teacher for six months to a year.

needs.title: Administrative staff
needs.detail: A long-term administrator is needed.

needs.title: Youth ministry leader
needs.detail: Mercylink wants a long-term leader for its youth ministry.

needs.title: Children's ministry volunteer
needs.detail: Volunteers are wanted for children's Bible classes and kids' programs.

needs.title: Accounting staff
needs.detail: The base needs an accounting staff member.

needs.title: Base staff (men, women and couples)
needs.detail: King's Kids Nasugbu lists separate openings for general base staff, including single men and women and married couples.

needs.title: Head cook / kitchen manager (high need)
needs.detail: YWAM Mandaluyong flags a high-need opening for a head cook and kitchen manager for one to two years. DTS completion required. Listing updated 20 May 2026.

needs.title: Children's ministry staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are wanted for the base's children's ministry.

needs.title: Base staff
needs.detail: YWAM Cagayan de Oro is recruiting long-term base staff.

needs.title: King's Kids performing arts staff
needs.detail: Short-term staff are wanted to lead performing-arts training for King's Kids.

needs.title: King's Kids logistics staff
needs.detail: Short-term logistics help is needed for King's Kids programs.

needs.title: Campus ministry staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed to reach students at Dumaguete's universities.

needs.detail: The base needs a long-term administrator.
