needs.detail: With only a few staff, the base is seeking people to staff its Discipleship Training School.

needs.title: Accounting staff
needs.detail: An accounting staff member is needed.

needs.title: Logistics and hospitality staff
needs.detail: The base lists openings for logistics staff and for hospitality staff.

needs.title: Mercy ministry staff or volunteer
needs.detail: YWAM Laguna welcomes staff or volunteers of any length who love people and want to serve its mercy ministry among poor communities.

needs.title: Children's ministry staff or volunteer
needs.detail: Children's ministry helpers are wanted in the communities the base serves.

needs.title: Family ministry staff or volunteer
needs.detail: The base seeks people for its family ministry.

needs.title: Worship leader
needs.detail: YWAM Laguna wants a long-term worship leader.

needs.title: Mercy ministry staff leading community Bible studies
needs.detail: Staff are needed to lead Bible studies for men and women in the slum communities the base serves. DTS graduates only. Updated 19 Sep 2026.

needs.title: Kids ministry staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are wanted for the base's kids ministry in slum communities.

needs.title: Base staff
needs.detail: YWAM Calbayog is recruiting long-term staff for its training and outreach work.

needs.title: Short-term volunteer staff
needs.detail: The base welcomes short-term volunteer staff.

needs.title: DTS, CBCC, SBCW and base staff
needs.detail: Long-term staff are needed for the base's DTS, its Christian child-care school (CBCC), its Bible-chronological school (SBCW) and general base work.

needs.title: Scholar sponsors and donors
needs.detail: Real LIFE invites one-time or monthly gifts (suggested PHP 1,000, 5,000 or 10,000) and full-year scholar sponsorships covering tuition, supplies and retreats for students from poor families.

needs.title: Corporate CSR partners
needs.detail: The foundation is seeking companies for annual CSR giving, employee matching and Benevity-linked giving to fund its scholars.

needs.title: Vocational instructors for at-risk youth
needs.detail: Instructors are needed in auto body, refrigeration and metal shop (for young men) and food preparation, salon and sewing (for young women) to train youth from poor families. Five-year commitment, basic Tagalog, youth-discipleship experience, and willingness to train a Filipino successor.

needs.title: Regional program officer for Mindanao
needs.detail: A program officer (single or couple) is sought for 2026 to lead all of the agency's Mindanao projects: outreach to unreached groups, training local leaders, community development, relief coordination, and budgets and reporting. Cross-cultural experience and ability to raise support are expected.

needs.title: October 2026 wishlist: food, milk and pantry staples
needs.detail: The village's October 2026 wishlist asks for fresh meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and eggs. It also asks for milk (fresh, condensed and powder), PediaSure/Similac 1-3, breakfast items, sugar, canned goods, rice, monggo beans, flour and condiments to feed the resident children.

needs.title: Maintenance and office supplies for the village
needs.detail: The October 2026 wishlist lists maintenance items: plastic rakes and broomsticks, dark green, white enamel and latex paint, roof paint, brushes and rollers, 1/4 plywood, a pressure washer and an electric leaf blower. For the admin office it asks for double-sided tape, A4 specialty paper and matte photo paper.

needs.title: Child sponsors for children with disabilities
needs.detail: The foundation says child sponsorship is what lets it house, educate, rehabilitate and train its residents with physical and intellectual disabilities. Sponsorship is also the first item on the October 2026 wishlist.

needs.title: Volunteers for daily childcare and community services
needs.detail: The village wants volunteers to help with daily care of the children and with its community services, and takes sign-ups through an online form. Groups can also join a short immersion program to work, eat and play alongside the teens and young adults who live there.

needs.title: OJT placements for SPED, PT, OT and social work students
needs.detail: Chosen Children Village offers on-the-job training to college students majoring in Special Education, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Social Work and Caregiving. Trainees support its therapeutic care for residents with disabilities.

needs.title: Medical fund for shelter children ($116,794)
needs.detail: A special project of $116,794 for the children's doctor visits, hospital stays, therapies, medical supplies and immunizations. Between a quarter and half of the shelter's children have special needs.

needs.title: Education fund and Cebu Children of Hope School days
needs.detail: The Education project ($216,001) covers the operating budget of Cebu Children of Hope School plus high school and college tuition, books, supplies and uniforms. Donors can also sponsor a single school day for $475.

needs.title: Family Traditions fund: birthdays, Christmas and activities
needs.detail: A $56,517 special project that pays for birthday parties, Christmas gifts, events and activities, children's allowances and appreciation for staff. These give the children a normal family life.

needs.title: Amazon wishlist for the Cebu children's homes
needs.detail: The shelter keeps a public Amazon wishlist (amazon.com/hz/wishlist/ls/7SNAMTOQQ7MK) of items for its homes. Supporters can buy and send these items directly.

needs.title: 3-month immersion volunteers
needs.detail: KIDS offers a 3-month immersion for volunteers who want more than a two- or three-week trip. Volunteers serve its children's homes, school, feeding and youth programs in Cuatro. Lodging for stays of 1 to 3 months costs about $40 per person per night.

needs.title: One-year interns with training and discipleship
needs.detail: A one-year internship for people who want a longer-term experience, with training and discipleship, serving in KIDS ministries such as Church Connect. KIDS also recruits full-time missionaries.

needs.title: Construction mission teams for classrooms and repairs
needs.commitment: short-term trip, dates arranged case by case
needs.detail: KIDS hosts construction teams to build classrooms, pour concrete floors, rebuild rooms and bathrooms, and handle smaller maintenance jobs at its base in Cuatro. It costs $60 per person per night for stays of 30 days or less, including lodging, meals and airport transfers. The base can host 60 to 100 people.

needs.title: Hope Alive Hospital (opening 2027) building fund
needs.detail: KIDS is raising support for Hope Alive Hospital, a Christ-centered hospital planned to open in 2027. It will grow out of the ministry's free Hope Alive pregnancy and birthing clinic for poor mothers.

needs.title: Meals and Values feeding program support
needs.detail: Through partner local churches, the Meals and Values program serves children in poor communities a weekly meal of lugaw (rice porridge) and builds relationships with them. The ministry takes one-time and monthly gifts for it.

needs.title: Street Children Worker (2+ years)
needs.detail: Brand New Day wants missionaries to reach street children and their families in Silang and Dasmarinas through street outreach, Bible studies, family counseling and a scholarship program. Workers may also start livelihood or shelter initiatives. Applicants need at least a year of Bible training and a pastoral recommendation.

needs.title: Brand New Day missions intern
needs.detail: Interns build relationships with street kids, youth and staff. They teach English or other skills such as music, visit families in slum communities, help cook and write newsletters, and pick up basic Tagalog along the way.

needs.title: Vocational instructors: auto body, refrigeration, metal shop
needs.detail: ACTION's vocational school in Silang needs men skilled in auto body, refrigeration and metal shop to train young people from poor families in Metro Manila and nearby provinces. Instructors disciple students, manage the shops and train Filipino successors.

needs.title: Vocational instructors: food prep, salon, seamstress
needs.detail: The same Silang vocational program needs women to teach food preparation, salon and sewing to young women from low-income families. Instructors bring Biblical teaching into the shop setting and work toward self-supporting shops run by national staff.

needs.title: Working Hands discipleship internship for tradesmen
needs.detail: A men-only internship in which interns use their trade skills to help missionaries give young men vocational training and discipleship.

needs.title: Annual appeal for girl survivors of abuse ($112,784 to go)
needs.detail: The GlobalGiving appeal has raised about $137,000 of its $250,000 goal. Gift levels: $10 for school supplies, $90 for a yearly psychological assessment, $250 for counseling and art or play therapy, and $3,000 for school preparation and skills training for girls rescued from the streets.

needs.title: Volunteers for the children's home in Pasig
needs.detail: The home takes volunteers aged 18 and over who speak Filipino or English and are self-reliant, flexible and adaptable. Applicants send a CV and application form by email and must show a medical clearance (chest x-ray and hepatitis profile).

needs.title: In-kind: milk, rice, produce, condiments, garbage bags
needs.detail: The home asks for milk products (Bear Brand, Bonnamil, Bonna Kid and Bonna Kid Pre-School), rice, fruits, vegetables, condiments such as soy sauce, cooking oil, salt, ketchup and sugar, and large black garbage bags.

needs.title: Operating support: shelter costs, food, medical care and schooling
needs.detail: Cash gifts pay for staff training and transport, the shelter's utilities, repairs and salaries, and each child's food, medical care, psychosocial support and education. As of mid-2026 the home cared for about 41 children aged 6 months to 14 years.

needs.title: Volunteer teachers for the homeschool program
needs.detail: The children's home runs an elementary homeschool program taught by volunteer teachers. The foundation also invites people to spend a working vacation serving at its orphanages.

needs.title: Volunteer nurses for regular health checks
needs.detail: The home relies on volunteer nurses to give its infants and young children regular health checks.

needs.title: Clothing, shoes, school supplies and toys
needs.detail: The Philippines Orphanage Foundation lists clothing, shoes, school supplies and toys as current needs for its orphanages, and the home also takes food and other basic goods.

needs.title: Milk formula, canned goods and pantry items for residents
needs.detail: Hospicio's wishlist asks for milk formula (NAN HW Two, Bear Brand, Nestogen, Nido, Ensure Gold, PediaSure 3+), canned meat, tuna and sardines, noodles and pasta, oats, bread, cooking oil, sugar, condiments and fresh milk drinks. These feed its children, elderly and residents in crisis.

needs.title: Diapers, toiletries and cleaning supplies
needs.detail: The list includes baby diapers (XL, XXL), adult diapers, baby wipes, lotions, soap, shampoo and toothpaste. It also asks for laundry detergent, bleach, dishwashing liquid, toilet cleaner, garbage bags and rubber gloves, plus school and office supplies such as bond paper, pads, tape and calculators.

needs.title: Appliances: water pressure tank, laptop, printer, refrigerator
needs.detail: Equipment requests include a pressure tank for the Tahan crisis center's water tank (about PHP 13,000), a laptop and a printer-scanner for admin and trainings, a refrigerator, a bathroom water heater, wall fans, a 2.5HP split-type aircon, a DSLR camera and a campus-wide audio system.

needs.title: Construction supplies for roofing, ceilings and gutters
needs.detail: Hospicio asks donors to call and discuss gifts of construction materials for repairs to roofing, ceilings and gutters on its historic campus.

needs.title: Volunteers to share time and talents
needs.detail: Hospicio welcomes volunteers to serve its children, elderly, residents with special needs and people in crisis, and asks them to inquire through its contact form.

needs.title: Interns in psychology, social work and human rights law
needs.detail: Preda takes Filipino and international students in psychology, social work, human rights law, counseling and the humanities. Senior social workers and therapists supervise them as they join daily life in the children's homes, home visits, jail visits and legal case work.

needs.title: Fund a rescue or a year of care for an abused child
needs.detail: EUR 150 funds the rescue of a child from abusers, and EUR 75 covers legal work to move a child from jail to the boys' home. EUR 1,500 to 2,500 a year covers shelter, therapy, schooling, food and personal items for a rescued child.

needs.title: Expand the Home of Love for trafficking survivors
needs.detail: The sisters are raising funds to expand the Home of Love in Tuburan so it can take in more girls and women rescued from sex trafficking. $100 a month cares for one girl in the home.

needs.title: Regina Coeli school sponsorships for rural children
needs.detail: The Regina Coeli Educational Program keeps rural children in school as a defense against exploitation. It aims to grow from about 18,000 to 35,000 students a year but has stalled for lack of funds. $25 a month enrolls one child with supplies, bag and fees.

needs.title: Fund daily meal outreach to women in the bars
needs.detail: The Hope Revive giving tier pays for meal outreach run with Church So Blessed in Angeles City, which serves 200+ meals a day to women working in bars at under $2 per meal. The meals open the door to relationships and offers of escape.

needs.title: Sponsor safe homes and survivors' college education
needs.detail: The House Revive and Heart Revive tiers fund safe homes for women and children leaving sex trafficking, and the women's education program, which pays for survivors' college studies.

needs.title: Volunteers for meal outreach in Angeles City
needs.detail: Volunteers can join the daily meal outreach with Church So Blessed in Angeles City, serving meals to women in the bars. Vision trips are paused for now.

needs.title: Support health, nutrition, education and respite care in Ifugao
needs.detail: Gifts pay for healthcare, nutrition, schooling and respite care for the home's orphaned, abandoned and malnourished children. They also fund its special needs learning centre and elementary and high school scholarships for mountain families in Banaue.

needs.title: Support 24/7 residential care for neglected children
needs.detail: Obed's House cares around the clock for 13 neglected children aged 5 to 12 in General Santos City. Suggested gifts of $30, $50 or $100 go to its ongoing residential care.

needs.title: Urgent 2026 appeal: $200,000 to meet the year's budget
needs.detail: The ministry says it needs $200,000 to finish 2026 with all program budgets met, and matching donors will double the first $40,000. The budgets cover its health, education, livelihood and faith programs for children at risk in Dumaguete.

needs.title: International volunteers in Dumaguete
needs.detail: Little Children of the Philippines invites volunteers to Dumaguete City to help rescue children from poverty, neglect and abuse. Volunteers can bring their training to strengthen existing programs or start new ones.

needs.title: Angel Christmas Cards fundraiser (order by Dec 5)
needs.detail: The ministry sells cards drawn by Filipino students in its Christmas card contest for $2 each, with a minimum of 5. Proceeds fund its programs, and orders are due by December 5.

needs.title: On-site volunteers for the community learning center
needs.detail: Island Kids is looking for motivated, proactive and creative volunteers with a heart for children to join daily life at its Cagayan de Oro learning center. Applicants request an information sheet and application form from volunteer@islandkids.ch.

needs.title: Child sponsorships and scholarships through university
needs.detail: The charity seeks child sponsors and donations for its village school, scholarships up to university level and its regenerative farm. These serve children and families from Cagayan de Oro's waste-picker community.

needs.title: Sponsor a child's schooling ($35/month)
needs.detail: $35 a month covers a child's school costs, uniform, shoes, backpack, lunches and books, and yearly sponsors can write to their child. Partner Airline Ambassadors also runs April and October trips to visit the home, and a college sponsorship program has started.

needs.title: Volunteers for children's home and education programs
needs.detail: The Balagtas home invites volunteers through its inquiry form. Volunteers help with its care of orphans and children of parents with leprosy or other debilitating illnesses, its schooling and life-skills programs, and community outings and spiritual activities.

needs.title: Full-time Software Developer, ICT Division
needs.detail: Silliman's ICT Division wants a developer to build and maintain software for university departments, and to test, debug and document it. The role is open to IT or Computer Science graduates, including fresh graduates. Applicants send a letter of intent and CV with the subject 'ICT Software Developer'.

needs.title: Full-time Social Work Instructor
needs.detail: The Social Work Department is hiring a full-time instructor. Candidates need a master's in social work, a valid PRC license and membership in the PASW and NASWE professional bodies. A doctorate is preferred.

needs.title: Elementary Filipino III Teacher
needs.detail: The School of Basic Education's elementary school needs a full-time Filipino teacher for Grade 3. Applicants should be licensed professional teachers with a master's degree or units toward one. A background in reading intervention or literacy development is preferred.

needs.title: Elementary English III Teacher
needs.detail: The School of Basic Education's elementary school is hiring a full-time Grade 3 English teacher. The role calls for a licensed professional teacher with a master's degree or units toward one. Experience in elementary reading and language instruction is preferred.

needs.title: University Associate Counsel
needs.detail: Silliman's Legal and Compliance Division wants a lawyer with 1-3 years of practice. The lawyer would review contracts, prepare pleadings, notarize documents and represent the administration in labor and disciplinary matters. Bar membership and MCLE compliance are required.

needs.title: Laboratory Farm Supervisor, College of Agriculture
needs.detail: The College of Agriculture needs a supervisor to run its teaching farm day to day. The role covers crop and livestock work, equipment, biosecurity and safety, farm staff and students' hands-on learning. An agriculture degree is required and a PRC agriculturist license is preferred.

needs.title: Director, Dr. Mariano C. Lao Global Studies Center
needs.detail: Silliman is looking for a director to set strategy for its Global Studies Center. The director would build programs and university partnerships and manage the center's marketing, operations and finances. A relevant master's degree and experience designing educational programs are required.

needs.title: Office Assistant, College of Engineering and Design
needs.detail: The College of Engineering and Design is hiring a full-time office assistant to support the college's administration. Applications go to Silliman's OD & HRM office as listed on the university careers page.

needs.title: Full-time and part-time Social Work faculty
needs.detail: CPU's jobs page lists full-time and part-time faculty openings in its Social Work Department. Inquiries go through the university's information center.

needs.title: Network Systems Supervisor
needs.detail: CPU is hiring a supervisor for its network systems, as listed on the university's current jobs page.

needs.title: Build the new College of Law and Medicine complex
needs.detail: CPU's 'Together We Build' campaign aims to raise PHP 250 million from 2025 to 2028 for a multi-storey building for its law and medicine colleges. The building will hold lecture halls, simulation rooms, a moot court and labs. Donors can adopt bricks from PHP 1,000 to PHP 50,000, give once, pledge monthly or partner as a company.

needs.title: School Principal
needs.detail: FIA lists a principal as a critical need: an experienced, creative leader to oversee daily operations, staff development and educational outcomes. Strong organizational and communication skills are required.

needs.title: Secondary Science Teachers (grades 6-12)
needs.detail: FIA needs at least two science teachers. In high school they would teach physical science, biology, earth and space, health, physics, chemistry and AP courses. In middle school they would teach life, physical and earth science. One to two years of teaching experience is preferred.

needs.title: Secondary Math Teachers (grades 6-12)
needs.detail: FIA lists at least two math positions as critical needs. The teachers would cover middle school general math and pre-algebra up through high school and AP courses. One to two years of teaching experience is preferred.

needs.title: Secondary Social Studies Teacher
needs.detail: FIA needs a teacher for middle school world studies and history, with possible high school electives or AP courses. One to two years of teaching experience is preferred.

needs.title: English / homeschool teachers for children's home
needs.detail: Obed's House wants a patient, organized teacher for its children aged 5-12. Many of them never attended school before arriving and struggle with literacy and math. The teacher would give Christian-based English or homeschool instruction. Short-, mid- and long-term and intern tracks are offered through ABWE.

needs.title: Guesthouse Assistant Manager
needs.detail: Doane Rest needs an assistant manager to coordinate daily hospitality. The role also covers budgets in QuickBooks and Microsoft 365, supervising staff and handling guest communications and reports. A heart for serving missionaries and pastors matters more than formal qualifications.

needs.title: Seminary teacher (theology, mentoring, pastor training)
needs.detail: WorldVenture is recruiting seminary teachers for institutions including Asian Theological Seminary in Manila, with further work in Bacolod and Davao. They would teach theology, mentor students and train about 40 pastors through a Pastoral Advancement Program. A master's degree and experience as a pastor, professor or church planter are required.

needs.title: Student scholarships and faculty support
needs.detail: ATS asks for gifts toward faculty salaries, scholarships, operating costs and faculty development. Its WorldVenture partner page puts a student's school expenses at about USD 1,000 a year. Donations can be made by bank deposit, check or the online portal, including GCash.

needs.title: Theological educator (BSOP, ATS, AGST or KTS)
needs.detail: OMF is placing theological educators to teach theology, ministry and leadership and mentor future pastors. Placements are at the Biblical Seminary of the Philippines, Asian Theological Seminary, Asian Graduate School of Theology or Koinonia Theological Seminary in Davao. The role needs an advanced theology degree, ministry experience, fluent English and willingness to learn Filipino.

needs.title: Scholarships, technology and facilities for APTS
needs.detail: APTS asks for gifts in four areas: infrastructure, equipment, technology and development. The money goes to scholarships, stronger academic programs, learning resources and campus upkeep for students training as pastors, missionaries and educators across Asia-Pacific.

needs.title: Professor to teach Bible subjects
needs.detail: World Team lists a professor opening at the Bicol Bible College of Leadership. The professor would teach a range of Bible subjects to a small cohort of 15-18 students and mentor them so they can train others.

needs.title: Support BCCL's leader training in Bicol
needs.detail: North American Baptists' 25th-anniversary article on BCCL invites gifts to the center and its leaders. BCCL is financially supported by NAB churches and runs entirely under Filipino leadership. It trains ministry leaders and runs food and Bible distribution.

needs.title: Land and buildings for a tribal Bible college
needs.detail: The project seeks USD 250,000 (about USD 97,800 raised so far) to start a self-supporting Bible college for tribal believers in Bicol. The money would buy land (USD 75,000), build classrooms, dorms, teacher housing and a USD 25,000 kitchen and dining hall, develop curriculum and supply rice until the first harvest.

needs.title: Livelihood entrepreneur for urban poor families
needs.detail: World Team wants someone with entrepreneurial skills to help squatter families build income-generating projects and teach them to provide for their own families. The person would work alongside its church-planting teams.

needs.title: Teach at Bible colleges and seminaries in Manila
needs.detail: World Team is recruiting teachers with Bible college or seminary experience to give theological education to national pastors and lay leaders at several Manila schools, and to mentor students.

needs.title: Christian counselor for trauma-affected children
needs.detail: World Team's Justice and Mercy team is seeking a trained, experienced Christian counselor to serve children and others who have been through trauma.

needs.title: College ministry worker at five Naga universities
needs.detail: World Team is looking for workers to build relationships with college students and student volunteers at five universities in Naga City and in Caramoan. Together the universities enroll more than 50,000 students.

needs.title: Program Officer (vocational / livelihood fieldwork)
needs.detail: KMBI's careers page, current as of July 2026, lists a Program Officer for field-based work. Applicants should be vocational or K-12 qualified, and fresh graduates are welcome. Applications go through the QR code on the careers page.

needs.title: IT Technical Services Manager
needs.detail: KMBI needs an IT Technical Services Manager with a CS or IT degree, at least 5 years of backend development and AWS expertise. KMBI also lists a Senior Application Development Manager role.

needs.title: Audio Visual Production Officer (producer/writer)
needs.detail: KMBI is hiring a producer and writer to create audio-visual content for its microfinance and community-transformation work.

needs.title: Junior Internal Auditors (branch and head office)
needs.detail: KMBI lists two branch-based junior internal auditor posts and one at its head office to audit its microfinance operations.

needs.title: Employee Welfare Associate
needs.detail: KMBI is looking for a staff member with a psychology or HR background and at least a year running employee programs, to look after the welfare of its 1,200 staff.

needs.title: Philippine Director of Health Operations
needs.detail: ICM is hiring a senior leader in Ortigas to manage and improve its health programs for ultra-poor families through strategic planning and partnership building.

needs.title: Junior Accountant
needs.detail: ICM's finance team needs a junior accountant in Ortigas. The work covers daily bookkeeping and month-end close in Xero, logging donations in Salesforce, issuing donor receipts and processing invoices and staff expenses.

needs.title: Sponsor schooling for children of inmates
needs.detail: PJPS asks for donors to sponsor the education of children of persons deprived of liberty. Its scholarship program supports students from grade school until they finish college.

needs.title: Socio-pastoral care volunteers at New Bilibid Prison
needs.detail: PJPS welcomes volunteers for its socio-pastoral care of vulnerable inmates: letter-writing, support, counseling, meals and medical missions. It also supports newly released people as they rejoin society.

needs.title: Stipends, food and Bible materials for women inmates
needs.detail: Gifts pay monthly stipends for the inmate leaders who run Bible studies, food and personal care items for prisoners, and discipleship materials at the Correctional Institution for Women. The ministry lost its founding missionary in 2022. A prison on Panay has asked for the same model. Suggested gifts are USD 30, 50 or 100.

needs.title: Swim Coach
needs.detail: Brent is hiring a swim coach at its Biñan, Laguna campus to teach swimming, keep students safe during pool activities and keep aquatics a supportive place to learn.

needs.title: Fund Bibles for isolated churches (Adopt-a-Church)
needs.detail: PBS's Adopt-a-Church and Funded Scripture Distribution programs give free Bibles and discipleship materials to isolated and disaster-hit churches that have none, along with leader training. Donations are taken through the PBS giving portal.

needs.title: Support the Filipino Sign Language Bible translation
needs.detail: PBS released 44 FSL video passages from Matthew, Mark and Luke in November 2025 and is working to complete the New Testament and then the full Bible in Filipino Sign Language. It invites gifts toward this demanding translation work.

needs.title: A Harvest of Hope in Mindoro – church multiplication ($6,000)
needs.detail: Project 154252 seeks $6,000 for seven young Nazarene congregations on Mindoro. Funds go to children's programs, community evangelism, outreach to tribal and underserved people, and training local ministers.

needs.title: Pathways in Palawan – outreach, prison and tribal ministry ($6,000)
needs.detail: Project 154253 aims to raise $6,000 to equip local partners in Palawan for church outreach, neighborhood children's programs, prison ministry and relationships with highland tribal communities.

needs.title: Philippines Earthquake Response (Cebu and Mindanao)
needs.detail: After the 2025 earthquakes in Cebu and Mindanao affected over 1.7 million people, Nazarene Disaster Response teams are giving food, water and medicine and running trauma-informed activities for children and teens. The fund is still accepting gifts.

needs.title: Philippines Disaster Response 2025 – equip churches to respond
needs.detail: This fund prepares local Nazarene churches and volunteers to respond quickly to typhoons, floods, fires and earthquakes with food, clean water, shelter and trauma care.

needs.title: Build a native church in Kabaya, Aklan ($2,245)
needs.detail: A new congregation in a previously unchurched barrio of Kabaya, Aklan has outgrown the home it meets in. The budget of $2,245 covers labor, materials, a restroom and a small kitchen, and members are supplying bamboo, site preparation and labor.

needs.title: Buy land for Life Grace Church in Kalibo ($17,500)
needs.detail: Life Grace Church and Grace Bible Training Center have outgrown the carport they meet in next to the Shepherds Home. A half-acre lot nearby costs $17,500; the mission suggests 10 families giving $1,750 each.

needs.title: Sound system for the Tapaz Bukidnon Tribal Center (~$4,400)
needs.detail: The Bukidnon tribal center in the Tapaz highlands is full every week with new believers. It needs 4 speakers ($928 each), 2 stands ($106 each) and 3 microphones ($155 each), about $4,389 in total, for the center and outreach events.

needs.title: Finish buying church land in Daja Sur ($2,450 remaining)
needs.detail: Thirty-five families in Daja Sur meet in a member's home and need a 550 sq m lot near the public square. Half of the $5,000 price has been raised, leaving $2,450.

needs.title: Renovate and enlarge Palayan, Mindoro church ($4,468)
needs.detail: The aging church building in Palayan, Mindoro has cracked walls and crumbling cement and is too small for the congregation. Phase 1 masonry costs $982 and Phase 2 ironwork, framing and painting costs $3,486. The church will pay for equipment rental.

needs.title: Rebuild six Wesleyan churches destroyed by the June 2026 quake
needs.detail: The magnitude 7.8 earthquake on 8 June 2026 destroyed six Wesleyan churches, including Glan Wesleyan Church, and a district center in southern Mindanao. Gifts through the TWC-GP Emergency Relief Fund pay for aid to members, demolition and cleanup, rice and water, and long-term rebuilding. About $6,750 had been given by 18 June.

needs.title: Earthquake relief led by Alliance churches in South Cotabato
needs.detail: Alliance churches in three districts are leading relief for families displaced by the June 2026 earthquake in South Cotabato and Sarangani. The Alliance Canada's Global Emergency Response is raising funds for food, clean water, shelter and medical help.

needs.title: Sarangani earthquake relief and rehabilitation fund
needs.detail: The Catholic bishops' conference asked dioceses to raise emergency funds for communities hit by the 8 June 2026 Mindanao quake. Gifts go through diocesan social action centers and Caritas Philippines for relief and rehabilitation.

needs.title: Build the St. Joseph mission chapel in Nangalisan, Tuba
needs.detail: Couples for Christ and the Diocese of Baguio are building a chapel to serve as a mission station for about 546 families in Nangalisan, Benguet. Gifts go to CFC Global Mission Foundation's Build My Church fund; no target amount is stated.

needs.title: Church building that doubles as evacuation center ($15,000)
needs.detail: The fellowship needs $15,000 for a solid church building among the Mangyan near Puerto Galera that the community can also use as an evacuation center during storms.

needs.title: Sanitation facilities for Mangyan church site ($2,000)
needs.detail: The church has listed $2,000 for sanitation facilities at its site serving indigenous Mangyan communities in Puerto Galera.

needs.title: Water supply for the church and community ($2,000)
needs.detail: The church is asking for $2,000 to put in a water supply. It also asks for help securing land for future church plants among unreached Mangyan communities.

needs.title: Ministry van for church-planting trainers
needs.detail: The OMS Philippines team needs a van so pastors and church-planting leaders can travel to train others in the provinces, sometimes driving up to 15 hours a day. The van would also carry short-term mission teams. Gifts go to OMS project account #408413.

needs.title: Free births for poor mothers ($305k still to raise)
needs.detail: Mercy In Action's GlobalGiving project has a $500,000 goal, with about $305,000 still to raise for free childbirth care. On the price list, $150 pays for one safe delivery and $500 buys a month of reusable clinic supplies.

needs.title: First 1,000 Days home visits for newborns ($46k remaining)
needs.detail: Midwives visit mothers and babies at home after birth through the child's first 1,000 days. The project has $46,170 left of a $98,000 goal, and $200 covers all visits for one baby.

needs.title: Building fund: a home for 70+ at-risk children
needs.detail: Brand New Day is building on its own land to house more than 70 children, up from 14 in rented space, and to give them education and skills training. Phases begin with a shelter building, then a multipurpose hall, a basketball court and more shelters as funds come in.

needs.title: Build a trauma-informed school building
needs.detail: On land donated in 2019, Project Pag-asa plans an accessible school building with a library, computer room and basketball court for 60+ children from orphanages. Construction may go in phases as funds are raised.

needs.title: Scholarships for graduates going on to further study
needs.detail: The scholarship fund pays for college or vocational study for Project Pag-asa graduates, children who have been through trauma, so that cost does not keep them from continuing.

needs.title: Operating costs for maternity and newborn care
needs.detail: Shalom moved to outpatient services in 2026 and needs operating funds for prenatal and postpartum care, cervical cancer screening, newborn checks, and its 'Little Warriors' support for babies with complex medical needs.

needs.title: Sponsor vocational and discipleship training for street youth
needs.detail: Gifts pay for an 8–10 month residential program for men aged 18–25 from Manila's streets: auto mechanics, welding, woodwork or computers, daily discipleship, dorm and meals, then 1,000 hours of on-the-job training.

needs.title: Support Lighthouse shelter for abandoned and abused children
needs.detail: The Lighthouse has cared for nearly 100 abandoned newborns, abused children and teens since 2017. It has built a new facility on its own property and plans more buildings, and donations fund care and expansion.

needs.title: Wi-Fi learning hubs in rural tribal churches
needs.detail: Phase 1 puts Wi-Fi antennas and routers in rural churches so children who walk 3–6 km to poor schools can join lessons streamed from Manila Church of God schools. Community Wi-Fi income then helps pay pastors and church-planting transport. No total cost is stated.

needs.title: Tagbanwa Church Planting Project
needs.detail: The project supports ministry among Palawan's Southern Tagbanwa: 19 village churches, worship and leader training, medical and dental help, and translation. Gifts go through Ethnos360 with the project noted in the memo, and the latest appeal was posted in September 2026.

needs.title: 2026 budget: wells, transport, training for tribal outreach ($55,750)
needs.detail: The team's 2026 goal is $55,750, with only $3,100 raised when the page was updated. The money covers water wells, fuel and transport, training national believers, women's prayer networks, discipleship, missionary care and digital outreach among unreached groups in the southern Philippines.

needs.title: Raise the Roof: materials for Charity Village community center
needs.detail: Donations buy building materials for a community center in Borongan that will mainly be a typhoon refuge for the poorest villagers. It will also host education, skills training and children's camps run with the Oikos Sisters.

needs.title: Physicians, NPs and PAs for Leyte clinic team (Mar 2027)
needs.detail: Global Health Outreach is recruiting medical providers for about seven days of clinics around Matalom, Leyte, including at least one day on a small offshore island of 4,400 people with almost no local healthcare. Cost is $2,395 plus airfare and a $150 application fee.

needs.title: Dentists and dental hygienists for Leyte mission (Mar 2027)
needs.detail: The March 2027 Leyte team lists dentists and dental hygienists among the roles it needs for its clinics in an underserved part of the island. Participants pay $2,395 plus airfare.

needs.title: Ophthalmologists and dermatologists for Leyte team
needs.detail: Global Health Outreach specifically asks for eye and skin specialists to join its 2027 Leyte clinics, where most patients have little or no access to care.

needs.title: Nurses, pharmacists, EMTs and non-medical servants for Leyte
needs.detail: The team also needs nurses, pharmacists, EMTs and paramedics, first responders and non-medical helpers to run its clinics in Matalom and a nearby island. Trip leader contact is through the posting.

needs.title: Physicians and APPs for Manila primary care trip (Nov 5-15)
needs.detail: AdventHealth Global Missions and Adventist Medical Center Manila run free primary-care clinics for communities near the hospital; providers give consultations. Total cost is $2,750, with the final $1,275 payment due October 9, 2026.

needs.title: Nurses for triage at Manila free clinics (Nov 2026)
needs.detail: Nursing volunteers handle triage and nursing care at the November 2026 free primary-care clinics run with Adventist Medical Center Manila.

needs.title: Pharmacy, PT/OT, imaging and lab volunteers (Nov 2026)
needs.detail: Allied clinical volunteers such as pharmacists, physical and occupational therapists, imaging and lab staff are wanted to support care at the Manila primary-care clinics.

needs.title: Non-clinical helpers for clinic operations (Nov 2026)
needs.detail: The AdventHealth trip also takes non-clinical volunteers to keep clinic operations running for the free community care days near Adventist Medical Center Manila.

needs.title: Partners for Negros Island's first cardiac cath lab
needs.detail: AdventHealth Global Missions lists a cardiac catheterization lab being developed at Adventist Medical Center Bacolod as a current project; it would be the first on Negros Island.

needs.title: General surgeons and anesthesiologists for Batangas mission
needs.detail: The February 2027 Tanauan/Talisay mission is a surgical mission; common cases include hernias and thyroid goiters. Cost is $950 plus a $50 application fee, applications close January 1, 2027, and 34 of 40 spots were open.

needs.title: Family medicine providers for Batangas clinics (Feb 2027)
needs.detail: Family medicine providers are needed to treat the hypertension, diabetes, respiratory, gastric and skin conditions common around Tanauan, Batangas.

needs.title: Dentists and optometrists for Batangas mission (Feb 2027)
needs.detail: Helping Hands Medical Missions lists dentists and optometrists among the specialties needed; dental infections are a major local issue and more than 5,500 people have received dental care on past trips.

needs.title: Nurses and OR personnel for surgical mission (Feb 2027)
needs.detail: Nurses and operating-room staff are needed to support surgeries and clinics during the 2027 Batangas mission.

needs.title: Pharmacists and physical therapists for Batangas mission
needs.detail: The posting also lists pharmacists and physical therapists among the roles needed for the February 2027 mission.

needs.title: Non-medical volunteers for Batangas mission (Feb 2027)
needs.detail: Non-medical volunteers are welcome to help run the clinics and share the Gospel during the Tanauan/Talisay mission.

needs.title: Long-term medical missionaries for Palawan Baptist Hospital
needs.detail: The hospital says it needs well-trained medical missionaries so the ministry can grow; physicians, nurses and other medical professionals are invited to serve.

needs.title: Ambulance, newborn equipment and a new hospital building
needs.detail: ABWE's giving page asks for an infant warmer and bili-light, an ambulance to move patients to higher-level care, and a new building to replace the 1979 structure, which is considered a fire hazard. Suggested gifts start at $30.

needs.title: Midwifery and maternal-health learners at birth center
needs.detail: Through INMED, the Olongapo birth center takes midwives, nurse-midwives, nurses, physicians, public health professionals and students interested in maternal and child health. Places are limited, and learners are asked to contact INMED about availability.

needs.title: Medical supplies, baby clothes and newborn hats
needs.detail: The birth centers in Olongapo and Tanauan, Leyte accept medical supplies, new or gently used newborn-to-toddler clothing, children's books and handmade newborn hats.

needs.title: Fund free births: midwives, supplies and food for mothers
needs.detail: Donations buy medical supplies and food for pregnant women in poverty and support the Filipino midwives who staff the free birth centers.

needs.title: Surgical supplies, ultrasound/EKG units and eyeglasses
needs.detail: The mission asks for sutures, scalpels, sterile drapes and gloves, ultrasound and EKG machines, and prescription eyeglasses for its free clinics in Mindanao.

needs.title: Fund medicines and year-round patient follow-up
needs.detail: Gifts pay for medicines, procedures and follow-up care that Filipino volunteers provide all year after the annual mission week, which serves more than 2,000 patients.

needs.title: Medical professionals for annual Mindanao mission week
needs.detail: Each year the mission recruits doctors, dentists, nurses, midwives, physical therapists, medical assistants and pharmacy staff from around the world; about 40 served in 2026. Dates for the next mission had not been announced.

needs.title: Medicines and supplies for 2027 medical mission
needs.detail: ANCOP is planning another Philippine medical mission in 2027 and is raising funds to buy medicines and medical supplies; the site has not been announced.

needs.title: Volunteer doctors for 6-week rolling clinics (Mindoro/Luzon)
needs.detail: Unpaid six-week assignments staff mobile clinics for Mangyan communities on Mindoro and indigenous groups in remote Luzon. Doctors need at least 18 months of experience and good English, are under 70 for a first mission, and pay at least half their airfare.

needs.title: Medical mission trip volunteers (Oct 12-22, 2027)
needs.detail: Hope 4 Kids lists a 2027 Philippines trip combining medical work and child sponsorship visits. Cost is $2,195 for adults or $2,095 for students, plus a $250 application fee and airfare.

needs.title: Vitamins for children in Mindoro and Marikina ($700)
needs.detail: The Philippines page lists $700 for vitamins as a current need, alongside classroom support ($5,000) and a feeding team ($2,218).

needs.title: Medical workers for mobile clinics and disaster response
needs.detail: Operation Blessing Philippines takes medical volunteers for its healthcare and disaster-response outreaches, providing food, supplies and volunteer coordination. Sign-up is through an online form.

needs.title: Counselors for disaster and community outreaches
needs.detail: Counselors are among the volunteer roles Operation Blessing lists for its disaster response, healthcare and children's programs.

needs.title: High School English Teacher (critical)
needs.commitment: 2026-2027 school year, full or part time
needs.detail: Faith Academy flags its high school English teacher opening for 2026-2027 as a critical position. Full-time or part-time candidates are welcome.

needs.title: English Language Learner (ELL) Coordinator
needs.detail: A critical, full-time support-division role coordinating English-language-learner services for students whose first language is not English.

needs.title: High School Principal
needs.detail: The principal runs the high school division: supervising staff and students, curriculum, budget and parent relations. Requires a teaching credential, at least five years of classroom experience and administrative experience; listed as a critical position.

needs.title: School Librarian

needs.detail: Faith Academy lists a librarian as a critical support-division opening for the 2026-2027 school year, full or part time.

needs.detail: Open elementary-division classroom teaching position for the 2026-2027 school year, available full or part time.

needs.detail: The elementary and support divisions are seeking a speech and language therapist to serve students, full or part time.

needs.detail: High school fine arts opening for a theater and drama teacher, full or part time.

needs.title: English Language Program teachers

needs.detail: Many APTS students from 30+ countries must improve their English before starting master's courses. Teachers are needed for the seminary's English Language Program.

needs.title: IT team leader (online classes, website, livestream)
needs.detail: The IT team supports online classes and learning platforms, updates the website and livestreams weekly chapel. APTS seeks a leader to coordinate the team and the graphic designers who make promotional media.

needs.title: Online Learning course builder
needs.detail: The Online Learning department needs someone to build courses in the learning management system and create videos, infographics and slides that help faculty prepare classes.

needs.title: Theological librarian
needs.detail: Oversee library services and book purchasing at one of the largest theological libraries in Asia, helping students complete their research.

needs.title: Campus maintenance supervisor
needs.detail: Supervise the maintenance staff so dormitories, faculty houses, offices, classrooms and a convention center stay in good working order and safe.

needs.title: Church-plant team: kids, youth, outreach & teaching
needs.detail: The team is launching an English-speaking international church in Davao, where many international students and school families have no English-speaking congregation. Helpers are wanted for children's and youth ministry, evangelism and hospital outreach, teaching, discipleship and leadership development.

needs.title: Ministry coordinator (missions, child sponsorship, microbusiness)
needs.detail: The team supports 43 Filipino missionaries, sponsors 600+ children through Kids Helping Kids, and has helped 85 families through the Restore500 microbusiness program, aiming for 500. It needs people to coordinate US partner groups and exposure teams, train workers, and help run these ministries.

needs.title: Aftercare team: counseling, medical, ESL & youth work
needs.detail: About 50 girls aged 4 to 21 live at the ranch at any time. It invites short-term to career workers in counseling/therapy, medical care, ESL, children's and youth ministry, and anti-trafficking work.

needs.title: Assistant Manager (hospitality & operations)
needs.detail: Doane Rest needs help coordinating daily hospitality, handling guest requests, managing budgets in QuickBooks, reporting to the field treasurer and managing local staff. It is open as a short-term trip, internship or long-term post.

needs.title: English teacher / homeschool teacher for children
needs.detail: Many children arrive having never attended school and struggle with reading and math. Obed's House wants a patient, organized person to teach English or homeschool the children.

needs.title: Marine biologist to lead coral reef restoration
needs.detail: Oversee a coral reef restoration project, lead research on reef, coral and turtle conservation, and train dive teams, while building relationships with local stakeholders.

needs.title: Coral restoration scuba diver/specialist
needs.detail: Certified divers are needed to maintain an extensive coral restoration project: underwater surveys, monitoring and establishing marine protected areas, in a remote location.

needs.title: Grant and curriculum writer for the Coral Reef Project
needs.detail: Help revise educational materials for local educators and research and write grant proposals for the Coral Reef Project in Caramoan, plus website, social media and fundraising videos.

needs.title: Social enterprise developer for coastal villages
needs.detail: Dwindling fish stocks leave coastal barangays needing other income. An entrepreneur is sought to help start alternatives such as eco-tours, aquaculture and jewelry-making.

needs.title: Church planter / college minister
needs.detail: Help establish a new church in Naga City and reach unreached college students through workshops, evangelistic Bible studies and discipleship, training believers to lead.

needs.title: Church planter among informal settlers
needs.detail: Join national and Western church planters living near and serving informal settler communities, with patient relational ministry that raises up local leaders and expands into unchurched areas.

needs.title: Trainer of church elders and leaders
needs.detail: Train national elders and leaders in sound doctrine and pastoral care through workshops and mentoring, so churches are self-governing and rooted in Scripture.

needs.title: Producer/translator of discipleship materials
needs.detail: Create, adapt and translate biblically sound, culturally relevant discipleship and leadership-training materials for an established church-planting network, and help plan trainings.

needs.title: Field administrator
needs.detail: Support Philippines field teams by organizing logistics and administrative details so other missionaries can focus on their ministries.

needs.title: Mobilization team members
needs.detail: SIM Philippines seeks people to help mobilize and equip churches, groups and individuals of all ages to send and go, by distributing materials and hosting mission events.

needs.title: Support services: leadership development & member care
needs.detail: This ministry equips and develops workers and partners through leadership development, retreats, seminars and a worker support scheme.

needs.title: Teaching elder for theological education
needs.detail: Teach and develop leaders at the All Nations Mission School to raise up the next generation of Mangyan pastors.

needs.title: NextGen ministry director
needs.detail: Train, equip and disciple ministry leaders and volunteers from the Mangyan church plants.

needs.title: Mercy ministry coordinator
needs.detail: Develop a structured community outreach plan to meet ongoing needs in Mangyan communities, working closely with Mangyan pastors and church plants.

needs.title: Medical professionals to start a clinic
needs.detail: The team is looking for medical professionals to start a clinic serving Mangyan communities.

needs.title: Church planting missionary in depressed areas
needs.detail: Plant churches among the poor under local churches in depressed areas of Metro Manila, reaching working language proficiency and assisting a church-planting mentor.

needs.title: Member care coordinator
needs.detail: Process and place new missionaries, interns and teams with the HR administrator, provide member care to Philippines-based missionaries, and orient new personnel in Metro Manila.

needs.title: Relief and development coordinator
needs.detail: Screen relief requests from missionaries' contacts and, after a major calamity, lead ACTION's relief response: surveying disaster areas and coordinating with local Christian leaders.

needs.title: Short-term ministry coordinator
needs.detail: Help the HR administrator receive and place short-term missionaries, interns, volunteer and visiting teams in Manila, including pre-field preparation.

needs.title: Facilities manager for expanded campus
needs.commitment: Min. 2-3 months; 6 months to career preferred
needs.detail: After finishing most of a large building project in 2026, Brand New Day needs an experienced person to supervise all maintenance and upkeep on site and train young men who help. Minimum commitment of a few months, with part-time language study.

needs.title: Street children worker
needs.detail: Join the team leading Bible studies, street outreach, family visits, and the scholarship and tutorial program for street children and families, and help with advocacy and fundraising.

needs.title: Vocational instructors: auto, metal, refrigeration, food, salon
needs.detail: Instructors are needed to train young men and women in Silang, Cavite: men for auto body, refrigeration and metal shop, women for food preparation, salon and seamstress work, while relating biblical principles to the shop.

needs.title: Trade-skills discipleship intern
needs.detail: Use your trade skills to build relationships with Working Hands students, encouraging them in faith while helping train them in a vocational skill.

needs.title: Midwife
needs.detail: Midwives are needed for prenatal and postnatal check-ups, labor and delivery support and patient records at Shalom Christian Birthing Home, sharing the gospel with poor mothers.

needs.title: Nursing / global health intern
needs.detail: Interns join Shalom's medical staff in outpatient maternity care (prenatal, postnatal, newborn checks, patient education) and rotate with other medical ministries.

needs.title: K-10 teachers (math, English, science, Filipino, PE, arts)
needs.commitment: At least one school year recommended
needs.detail: Teaching positions are open for grades K-10 in math, English, science, Filipino, Filipino history, PE, art and music, working with a lead teacher and students with high learning needs.

needs.title: Island ministry intern
needs.detail: Interns first learn language and culture, then join discipleship and evangelism in a typhoon resettlement community and on remote islands.

needs.title: Volunteer Coordinator
needs.detail: Build OMF Philippines' volunteer program: recruit, onboard and place local and expat volunteers with the Field Director and strategy leaders. Listed with a March 2026 start.

needs.title: Human Resources Personnel Manager
needs.detail: Plan and run HR policies, recruitment and personnel administration for the OMF Philippines field team of missionaries, employees and volunteers.

needs.title: Field Medical Advisor (doctor)
needs.detail: A doctor with general medical experience is needed to give medical advice, screening and reviews to 50+ OMF members and children in the Philippines.

needs.title: Seminary theological educator
needs.detail: Teach theology, ministry, preaching and leadership at partner schools such as AGST, Biblical Seminary of the Philippines, Asian Theological Seminary and Koinonia Theological Seminary, and mentor students.

needs.title: Non-formal theological trainer and mentor
needs.detail: Train and mentor current and future church leaders through informal theological education in local churches and evangelical networks, mostly in rural areas.

needs.title: Church planters for urban and rural communities
needs.detail: Serve alongside partner churches to share the gospel, disciple believers and meet practical needs in education, health and livelihood.

needs.title: Provincial college ministry worker
needs.detail: Join mostly Filipino teams in the provinces to evangelize and disciple college students and connect them with local churches.

needs.title: Professionals: health, teaching, ethnoarts & livelihood
needs.detail: OMF seeks people with skills in healthcare, nutrition, teaching, horticulture, finance, counseling, music, art and sport to live among and serve communities; ethnoarts and ethnomusic skills are especially wanted.

needs.title: Media creator & content team
needs.detail: Visual storytellers, writers, photographers and video producers are needed to tell what God is doing in the Philippines for mobilization campaigns and events.

needs.title: Serve Asia short-term missions coordinator
needs.detail: Screen, prepare, receive and debrief short-term workers serving under a year in the Philippines. The role is based in Manila or Davao.

needs.title: Relief and rehabilitation fund for Mindanao quake survivors
needs.detail: After the June 8, 2026 magnitude 7.8 earthquake off Sarangani, the bishops' conference asked parishes and Catholic institutions to give toward emergency relief and reconstruction. Funds are routed through diocesan social action centers and Caritas Philippines for affected communities in Sarangani, General Santos and the Lake Sebu area.

needs.title: Recovery support for typhoon and quake families in Masbate and Cebu
needs.detail: Caritas Philippines and Caritas Masbate are helping about 1,600 families recover from late-2025 typhoons and the Cebu earthquake with rice, shelter repair vouchers, household items, cash aid and replacement tools for farmers and fisherfolk. The update stresses that recovery will take time and links a donation page for continued support.

needs.title: Join the Alay Kapwa donor community
needs.detail: Caritas Philippines invites individuals to sign up for its 'Be 1N A Million' Alay Kapwa donor program, the standing support base for its disaster response and social action work. Sign-up is by an online form, and questions go to its communications office.

needs.title: Cash donations for Mayon eruption evacuees
needs.detail: After Mayon Volcano's May 3, 2026 eruption affected some 195,000 people in Guinobatan, Camalig, Oas and Ligao City, the diocese's Social Action Center appealed for cash to support families in evacuation centers. Gifts go to the Social Action Center's bank account or GCash, with proof of transfer sent via its Facebook page.

needs.title: Food, water and face masks for ash-hit evacuation centers
needs.detail: The Social Action Center asked for in-kind donations of food, drinking water and face masks for families displaced by Mayon ashfall. The drop-off point is the Social Action Center at the Albay Cathedral compound in Legazpi City.

needs.title: Earthquake relief for Marbel diocese and Lake Sebu communities
needs.detail: The Diocese of Marbel's social action center is the main channel for church relief to General Santos City, South Cotabato and Sarangani after the 2026 quake. Some indigenous communities around Lake Sebu were still hard to reach, and other dioceses were sending money directly to Marbel to support relief and rehabilitation.

needs.title: Rebuild homes for quake families still living in tents
needs.detail: CAMACOP reports that many families in Sarangani, South Cotabato and General Santos City are still in tents after the June 2026 earthquake. Rebuilding homes is listed as a critical ongoing need, and gifts are received through the Alliance World Fellowship giving page.

needs.title: Reconstruct 16+ quake-damaged Alliance church buildings
needs.detail: More than 16 CAMACOP church buildings in the earthquake zone (Glan, Camahual, Butulan and other communities) were damaged. Rebuilding them is listed among the critical ongoing needs.

needs.title: Solar lighting for quake-hit communities without power
needs.detail: With roads and electricity still under repair in parts of Sarangani, CAMACOP lists solar lighting for affected communities as an ongoing need.

needs.title: Restore schools and livelihoods after the Sarangani quake
needs.detail: Alongside housing and church rebuilding, CAMACOP names restoring schools and family livelihoods as a longer-term recovery need for the communities it serves.

needs.title: Emergency relief fund for Sarangani earthquake survivors
needs.detail: UCCP CARES is distributing food, water, hygiene kits, blankets, sleeping mats and clothing and providing medical and psychosocial care, with a focus on children, pregnant women, the elderly and people with disabilities. Partner churches abroad (UEM in Germany, PC(USA) via Presbyterian Disaster Assistance) are collecting gifts for this response.

needs.title: Temporary shelters and solar power for displaced families
needs.detail: Part of the UCCP response is setting up temporary shelters and installing solar power systems for light and communication in communities where water and electricity were cut and roads damaged. Several UCCP sanctuaries in the region were also severely damaged.

needs.title: Food packs and safe drinking water for displaced families
needs.detail: The NCCP's assessment through local ecumenical groups put food assistance and safe drinking water at the top of the priority needs. More than 40,000 people were displaced across 163 barangays in Regions IX, XI and XII.

needs.title: Hygiene kits and sleeping materials for evacuees
needs.detail: Essential non-food items, specifically hygiene kits and sleeping materials, were among the priority needs the NCCP identified for families displaced by the Mindanao earthquake.

needs.title: Temporary shelter for families displaced by the quake
needs.detail: Temporary shelter for displaced households is listed among the NCCP's priority needs. Donations reach the response through ACT Alliance members such as the United Church of Canada, where 85% of each gift goes to this crisis.

needs.title: Psychosocial support and protection for women and children
needs.detail: The NCCP lists psychosocial support and protection services, especially for women and children, as a priority need after the earthquake. Psychosocial support is one of the four activities in its ACT Rapid Response Fund response, alongside cash, food and WASH.

needs.title: WASH services in earthquake-affected barangays
needs.detail: Water, sanitation and hygiene services are a core part of the NCCP's earthquake response, which received USD 149,000 from the ACT Rapid Response Fund for about 32,900 affected families.

needs.title: Transitional housing for 150 displaced households
needs.detail: Phase 2 of the Mustard Seed Mission response plans shelter support and the construction of medium-term transitional housing for 150 earthquake-affected families, coordinated with PHILRADS and local churches. The full three-phase budget is about NT$10.6 million (~USD 325,000).

needs.title: Home repairs for 55 quake-damaged households
needs.detail: The recovery and rebuilding phase includes repairing homes for 55 households damaged in the 2026 Mindanao earthquake.

needs.title: Cash-for-work jobs for 40 earthquake-affected residents
needs.detail: Phase 3 plans a cash-for-work program employing 40 local residents in recovery work, so families can earn income while their communities rebuild.

needs.title: Education kits for 300 children affected by the quake
needs.detail: The plan includes education kits (stationery, school bags and books) for 300 children whose schooling was disrupted. Earlier phases trained 20 local volunteers to accompany 500 affected children with psychosocial support.

needs.title: Rebuild six destroyed churches and a district center
needs.detail: Six Wesleyan churches and one district center in Southern Mindanao were destroyed by the June 2026 earthquake, and demolition and cleanup have begun. The denomination's Global Partners Emergency Relief Fund (about $6,750 raised by June 18) supports reconstruction and recovery.

needs.title: Temporary worship spaces for congregations that lost buildings
needs.detail: Congregations whose sanctuaries were demolished need temporary places to worship while rebuilding plans move forward.

needs.title: Practical relief for church members and neighbors
needs.detail: District teams are distributing bottled water, rice and other supplies to church members and surrounding communities. The relief fund supports this practical aid to affected congregants.

needs.title: Repair T'boli church building and quake-cracked parsonage
needs.detail: In T'boli, South Cotabato, the unfinished Nazarene church building suffered structural damage and is at risk of collapse, and the pastor's parsonage has cracked flooring and a damaged pillar. The region asks for continued disaster response support.

needs.title: Shelter rehabilitation for General Santos daycare families
needs.detail: More than 100 families linked to the General Santos City Church of the Nazarene daycare ministry had homes damaged or destroyed. The church is providing shelter care and rehabilitation help for about 120 community members, along with food packs and child-focused activities.

needs.title: Philippines Disaster Response fund: food, water, shelter, trauma care
needs.detail: Nazarene Compassionate Ministries runs a Philippines disaster response fund for local churches responding to typhoons, earthquakes, fires and floods in Cebu, Masbate, Mindoro and Taytay, Rizal. It covers food, clean water, shelter and trauma care.

needs.title: Give to ADRA Philippines' emergency fund
needs.detail: ADRA Philippines asks for gifts to its emergency fund, which pays for immediate disaster assistance, recovery work and building local resilience to future shocks.

needs.title: COLMEAL Officer (Hub)
needs.detail: ADRA Philippines is hiring a COLMEAL Officer for its hub team at the Silang, Cavite office. Applications close October 9, 2026, and full requirements are in the linked job specification.

needs.title: Juan Build volunteers for house construction days
needs.detail: Habitat Philippines' Juan Build program places volunteers on half-day or full-day construction work in Habitat communities. Groups and individuals sign up through the online volunteer form.

needs.title: Juan Brigade trainers for financial literacy and health
needs.detail: The Juan Brigade program asks volunteers to run community development activities beyond construction, such as leadership seminars, financial literacy training and health programs for Habitat homeowner communities.

needs.title: Support disaster shelter repair and resilient core homes
needs.detail: Habitat Philippines' disaster response provides shelter repair kits, tools, materials and trained carpenters right after disasters. It then builds disaster-resilient core shelters in safer areas and runs preparedness training, and it invites individuals and organizations to fund this work.

needs.title: Shelter, food and water for northern Cebu quake survivors
needs.detail: Working with local churches in Bogo, Tabogon and San Remigio, Samaritan's Purse has given shelter kits to 2,700+ families and food to over 2,000, as many stayed displaced through the monsoon season. Gifts to its International Emergency Relief fund cover immediate needs and longer-term recovery.

needs.title: Philippines earthquake and typhoon relief gifts
needs.detail: Operation Blessing asks for one-time or monthly gifts for families in Cebu hit by the 6.9 earthquake and later typhoons. Its local team provides meals, water filtration, hygiene kits, solar lamps, medical supplies and psychological first aid.

needs.title: Rebuild homes and church sanctuaries in the Mindanao quake zone
needs.detail: PHILRADS is the ground partner for assessments and relief after the June 2026 earthquake, where local churches turned sanctuaries into evacuation centers. The partner appeal (via International Christian Concern) seeks funds to rebuild homes, repair damaged churches and give trauma support to survivors.

needs.title: Restore Sta. Rosa de Lima shrine and aid Daanbantayan survivors
needs.detail: Archbishop Alberto Uy appealed for financial and in-kind support after the archdiocesan shrine of Sta. Rosa de Lima in Daanbantayan was heavily damaged in the September 2025 quake. Restoration of nine damaged northern Cebu churches is slated for 2026, and parishes say they cannot carry the costs alone.

needs.title: Parishes to 'adopt' quake-hit parishes in northern Cebu
needs.detail: The archbishop urged unaffected parishes to adopt earthquake-hit parishes and send them steady relief and help with recovery. He also asked parish priests to raise funds and in-kind donations for survivors.
